hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Africa, north of Democratic Republic of the Congo || vast, flat to rolling plateau; scattered hills in northeast and southwest || landlocked; almost the precise center of Africa || Resources: diamonds, uranium, timber, gold, oil, hydropower || Exports: gold, wood, diamonds, vehicle parts/accessories, cotton (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: vast, flat to rolling plateau; scattered hills in northeast and southwest || Central Africa, north of Democratic Republic of the Congo

climate.excerpt: tropical; hot, dry winters; mild to hot, wet summers || hot, dry, dusty harmattan winds affect northern areas; floods are common

economy.excerpt: enormous natural resources; extreme poverty; weak public institutions and infrastructure; political and gender-based violence have led to displacement of roughly 25% of population; Bangui-Douala corridor blockade reduced activity and tax collection; strong agricultural performance offset COVID-19 downturn || Exports: gold, wood, diamonds, vehicle parts/accessories, cotton (2023) || Industries: gold and diamond mining, logging, brewing, sugar refining
